posts.title: How our free move-out estimate works in Greer
posts.text:
Planning move out cleaning in Greer, SC and not sure what it will take? We start with a free in-home estimate, because no two homes need the same amount of work.

You book a time that fits your move. Someone from our team comes to the house, walks through every room and looks at the things that decide the job: the inside of the oven and refrigerator, cabinets and drawers, closet shelves, bathroom grout, window tracks and the condition of the floors. Homes near Downtown Greer and Trade Street often have older cabinets and tile that take longer than a newer build off SC-101 or near GSP Airport.

After the walkthrough you get an exact price for your home. There is no commitment, and you decide if it works for you. Renters like this because they know the cost before the final inspection, and sellers like it because the cleaning gets booked before closing week gets crowded.

posts.title: Office cleaning in Wellford before the holiday rush
posts.text:
November is when small businesses in Wellford, SC start getting more foot traffic, more clients stopping in and more year-end visitors. Office cleaning Wellford SC owners can count on keeps the front of the business looking right while you stay busy.

For shops and offices along US-29, the entry area takes the most punishment this time of year. Wet shoes, leaves tracked in from the parking lot and fingerprints on glass doors show up fast. Our team wipes desks, counters and workstations, cleans the glass at the entrance, and goes over the high-touch spots such as door handles, light switches and keypads.

Restrooms are cleaned, disinfected and restocked, the break room sink and microwave are wiped, trash and recycling go out, and the floors are vacuumed and mopped. We schedule around your hours so the work happens when it bothers you least.

posts.title: What makes Brazilian house cleaning different?
posts.text:
People in Startex, SC ask us this a lot: what is Brazilian house cleaning, and how is it different from a regular maid service? The short answer is that it is detail first and done by hand.

Instead of spraying and wiping the obvious surfaces, our team wipes each surface by hand, works the corners and edges with a cloth, and moves small items to clean under them. Door frames, light switches and handles get attention, bathrooms are scrubbed down to the grout and the toilet base, and the kitchen is degreased around the stovetop, hood and cabinet fronts. Floors are washed by hand along the walls, where dust collects first. Before we leave, we walk the house against a room checklist.

This method suits homes with hardwood, tile and grout, and families who have been let down by a rushed clean. Many houses around the Startex mill village and the Duncan and Lyman area have details worth the extra care.
